subject.title: [Bug]: Notarized macOS app auto-terminates ~0.5s after launch (no menu-bar icon) in remote mode — macOS 26

question: Should maintainers keep this issue open until a latest notarized macOS 26 remote-mode launch is reproduced or disproven?
rationale: Current source and latest release still exercise the reported path, while the only adjacent fix proof was a locally signed app and explicitly did not cover release notarization or full packaging.

options.title: Keep open for notarized proof
options.body: Run the latest notarized app on macOS 26 in remote mode and use the result to scope a lifecycle/status-item/signing fix or close with release-backed evidence.

options.title: Close after disproving on release
options.body: Close later if a current notarized release demonstrably stays resident and shows its menu-bar icon under the reported remote-mode setup.

recommendation.title: Keep open for notarized proof
recommendation.body: Run the latest notarized app on macOS 26 in remote mode and use the result to scope a lifecycle/status-item/signing fix or close with release-backed evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and landed the closest macOS menu-bar and launchd lifecycle fixes and are the best available routing candidate from the observed history.
